SD41-X01.name: The MakaiPhantomDragon Siegfried-Necro
SD41-X01.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Twinkle Necromancy] (When Advents)
You can summon Cost 0/1/3/6/9 Spirit cards, one of each, from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Ancient Dragon"/"Astral Dragon"/"Ogre Wizard" family Spirit attacks, the opponent can't block unless they destroy one of their Spirits.

SD41-005.name: Jadgas
SD41-005.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. Then, by paying one cost, send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

SD41-003.name: Smog Hand
SD41-003.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Summon a Cost 1 or less Purple Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

SD41-002.name: The MakaiFogDragon Mistwurm
SD41-002.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By discarding two cards from your Hand, summon this card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

SD41-006.name: The MakaiDragonOgre Darkwurm
SD41-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By sending one of your Lives to the Trash, draw two cards. Your Bursts can't activate via this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Nexus to the Reserve.

SD41-007.name: The MakaiEmperorDragon Darkwurm-Regalia
SD41-007.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red/Purple & Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

When [adventing] this card onto a Cost 3/4 Spirit you control, you can [Advent] it without sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash.

[LV1]LV2]LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy all opposing Spirits/Ultimates with one core on them, and draw a card for each destroyed Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2296.name: The MakaiMarshal BurguHearts
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2296.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent)
Send two cores each from every non-"Makai"-named Spirits to the Reserve. If this Burst is activated during (Your Turn), for each Spirit depleted by this effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For every 10 cards in your Trash, this Spirit gains an extra Purple symbol.

SD41-008.name: The DivineHellGun Armillary-Sphere
SD41-008.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more]

[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. When any Spirit is depleted by this effect, draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.

SD41-001.name: Death Returner
SD41-001.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 0/3] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 0/3 Spirit is destroyed.

SD41-004.name: The MakaiSoldier Curse Swordsman
SD41-004.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending a core from any opposing Spirit that the opponent chooses to their Reserve, draw a card.
